messages:
ryan: Heads-up — midday maintenance in apac-west1 today 12:30 UTC. Rolling reboots for 'thermal-cohort-03' to address intermittent NIC flaps and thermal drift. Plan: cordon 6 nodes -> reboot -> uncordon, repeat across 4 batches. ETA ~90m.

alisa: Noted. Will this reduce available GPU capacity for hosted traffic?

ryan: We'll reserve ~150 GPUs in us-east1 as burst for 60m and route low-priority workloads to preemptible pools. Hosted API SLOs should hold, small latency bump for some embedding requests.

sanjay: Can we prime KV cache after each uncordon? Rebuild spikes token cost if cold.

ryan: Yes — we'll run `kv-seed --pool=apac-west1 --cohort=thermal-cohort-03 --concurrency=8` after each batch uncordon. Also will seed 2 canary nodes first to validate caches.

lin: @oncall-sre please ack and watch NIC err rates during batch 2/4. Also want support to pre-authorize tenant failovers for critical customers.

oncall-sre: Acked. I'll monitor `nic_err_rate` and `tx_retries` dashboards. If `nic_err_rate > 0.2%` or `p95 latency > 200ms` we stop and rollback.

ops-bot: Maintenance window created (id: mw-1825-thermal). Reminder: update status page 30m before start and post completion note.

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled +15m after start: 5 synthetic requests/min to model-cpu-fallback, 3 target checks. Will report pass/fail to thread.

ryan: Quick runbook highlights:
- Step 1: cordon batch via `racks cordon --label=thermal-cohort-03 --count=6`
- Step 2: reboot and wait for NVMe/drivers to come back (~6-8 min)
- Step 3: run `kv-seed` and healthcheck `curl -sS http://local-health/ready`
- Step 4: uncordon and observe 10m.

alisa: Cost heads-up — east-burst reservation + preemptible shift ~ $1.6k for window, charge to infra ops. Worth it vs risking tenant disruptions?

ryan: Agreed — we accept the delta. We avoid longer SLA incidents if we don't act.

lin: I'll draft customer comm for support to push if canary shows any regressions. :email:

oncall-sre: I'll post interim updates at 12:45 and at completion.

ryan: thanks all. Will ping again 45m before start to confirm final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
